metadata.title: Medora: A Bilingual, consent-gated AI-native healthcare management & consultation platform for Bangladesh
metadata.description: Medora is open-source research software that joins bilingual English and Bengali patient-held records and appointment coordination to a consent-gated assistive-AI layer of twenty-one endpoints. Its safety properties are structural rather than prompt-dependent: external model calls need a purpose-specific revocable grant and pass bilingual redaction and pseudonymisation, assistant navigation resolves through an immutable role-scoped registry that holds no administrative routes, and summary items can cite only records the backend supplied. Routing, consent, and red-flag detection involve no model. Underneath sits an open Bangladesh medicine reference of 7,389 drugs and 67,001 brands, built from five published datasets by a single script. Medora is not clinically validated and is not a medical device.
metadata.notes: Research software. Not clinically validated, not a medical device, and not for clinical use. The archive contains source, evaluation harnesses, and the build script for the medicine reference. No patient images or records are included; see samples/DATA_USE_NOTICE.md.
